title: Sales Representative (iGaming B2B)
description:
Description
We're hiring a Sales Representative to drive new business across priority African and European gambling/gaming operator markets. You'll own the full sales cycle - from market scanning and lead identification through qualification, negotiation, and contract signature - then hand off cleanly into our 25-day client onboarding process.
Key Responsibilities:

• Learn the company platform, its business units and core iGaming terminology well enough to run credible discovery calls and demos.

• Scan and score countries and individual operators for market potential and licensing readiness.

• Build and work a structured outreach pipeline from the operator database.

• Run qualification → demo → proposal → negotiation → contract to signature.

• Understand the licensing/regulatory path well enough to set realistic client timelines.

• Hand off signed clients cleanly into the onboarding team.

• Report pipeline status, activity and forecast on a weekly/monthly cadence.

Requirements
Requirements:

• 2+ years B2B sales with full-cycle ownership and an independently hit quota.

• iGaming, betting or SaaS platform sales background.

• Data-driven prospecting - market/country scanning, disciplined CRM hygiene.

• Negotiation and closing to contract signature.

• Working knowledge of gambling/gaming licensing and regulatory processes per market (or proven fast learning of a regulated domain).

• Strong written and verbal English.

• Comfortable with international travel and fully remote client relationships.

• Self-directed and resilient in a fast-moving startup environment.

Nice-to-have

• Existing relationships with gaming/betting operators, affiliates or regulators in African or European markets.

• Prior experience selling into emerging markets.

• Additional languages: French, Portuguese, Arabic.

description:
Edge Computing AI Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Edge Computing AI Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000-$105,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are looking for an Edge Computing AI Engineer to design, optimize, and deploy machine learning models that run efficiently on resource-constrained edge devices, including mobile platforms, embedded systems, and specialized accelerators. The role requires deep expertise in model compression, quantization, and hardware-aware optimization, along with strong systems engineering skills to ship reliable AI capabilities outside the data center. The ideal candidate has shipped edge AI in production environments where compute, memory, energy, and connectivity constraints fundamentally shape the engineering trade-offs.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

• Six or more years of experience in ML engineering, with significant work on edge or mobile AI.

• Strong proficiency in Python and C++.

• Hands-on experience with model compression, quantization, and pruning techniques.

• Experience with at least one major edge inference framework.

• Solid understanding of mobile and embedded hardware architectures.

• Experience deploying ML models to production on mobile or embedded platforms.

• Strong performance engineering and profiling skills.

• Familiarity with on-device privacy and security considerations.

• Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with custom NPU or DSP toolchains.

• Familiarity with federated learning or on-device personalization.

• Exposure to safety-critical or industrial edge deployments.

• Open-source contributions to edge AI frameworks.

• Experience optimizing LLMs for on-device inference.

Location: Equality Now is a remote organization. This position may be based in Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Virginia, or Washington, D.C., with a strong preference for candidates based in New York.
MISSION OBJECTIVE:
The Director, Major Gifts plays a pivotal role in advancing Equality Now ’s global mission by leading and growing a major gifts portfolio, including gala sponsorships, mid-level giving and donor engagement. In partnership with the Chief Development Officer and Chief Executive Officer, the Director translates Equality Now ’s development strategy into actionable fundraising plans, strengthens donor pipelines and systems, and cultivates meaningful relationships with individuals, family foundations, and philanthropic networks.This role spans strategy, donor cultivation and stewardship, portfolio management, events, executive engagement, and team leadership, and collaborates closely with Annual Giving & Development Operations functions. It requires an experienced fundraising leader with sound judgment, strong relationship-management skills, cross-cultural fluency, and the ability to translate Equality Now ’s complex legal and programmatic work into compelling opportunities for philanthropic investment.
The Director will have the opportunity to shape and strengthen Equality Now ’s Individual and Major Giving program during an important period of organizational growth. The successful candidate must be comfortable building systems, navigating complexity, inspiring donors and colleagues, and building the capacity of supervisee(s) and other junior staff focused on securing sustainable revenue to advance legal and systemic change for women and girls worldwide.
MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
The following provides a general outline of the role. It is not exhaustive, and responsibilities may evolve at the discretion of the CDO based on organizational needs and priorities.
Purpose: Innovate for Mission Expansion

• Serve as the senior lead for operationalizing the Individual & Major Giving strategy, translating our 2026-2030 development strategy into actionable plans, systems, and donor pathways across the full Individual Giving portfolio.

• Drive the execution and refinement of Equality Now ’s high-touch major donor growth strategy, including implementing a network-mapping approach, strengthening Advisory Board and Ambassador engagement, building individualized strategies for UHNW, and designing innovative donor/prospect engagement initiatives (eg-salons, donor cohorts, donor journeys, in-kind/volunteer opportunities for mission impact)

• Partner with the CEO and CDO to support high-value donor/prospect cultivation and shape donor-facing opportunities aligned with organizational priorities, advising on donor motivations, portfolio insights, and potential engagement opportunities.

• Provide strategic leadership to align all tiers of individual giving-major gifts, gala sponsorships, mid-level, and annual giving-ensuring cohesive messaging, clear donor journeys, and seamless handoffs between donor segments.

• Lead maintenance and continuous improvement of pipeline development and tracking practices, including
donor qualification, engagement strategies, moves management, and standardized systems that enhance efficiency, clarity, and visibility across the portfolio.

• Lead/guide the development of donor-facing cases for support, investment opportunities, and strategic offerings, ensuring they reflect Equality Now ’s mission, program vision, and funder-aligned messaging.

Engagement: Advocate

• Manage a portfolio of high-value donors and prospects, cultivating deep, trust-based relationships with individuals and family foundations capable of $10,000-$250,000+ giving, while identifying opportunities and supporting leadership-level engagement.

• Support CEO and CD

We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Process Development team builds the platform that enables biotech and pharmaceutical companies to design, execute, and manage complex scientific manufacturing processes at scale. Our workflow engine is the foundational layer - a system that lets scientists and operators model their processes as structured workflows and then execute them reliably, whether one person is doing everything or an entire team is coordinating across steps.

As a Software Engineer on this team, you'll work full-stack across Workflows, Recipes, and Assays - the core products that Benchling customers depend on to run their operations. You'll build features that show up directly in how scientists manage manufacturing workflows, integrate our products with the wider Benchling ecosystem to help customers automate their work, and shape how AI tooling gets integrated into our products.

TEAM MISSION

The Process Execution (PE) team builds where life sciences move from the physical lab into digital records. We own the workflow engine and multiple products built on top of it (Workflows, Recipes, Assays, Requests, and Worklists). Our goal is to empower biotechs (from startups to multi-nationals) to speedup development and manufacturing of life-saving treatments (the D in R&D). Our foundation is our orchestration platform that allows complex physical processes to be mapped to their digital twins. On top of the platform, the team builds opinionated products to help customers optimize their physical process execution. These are mission critical workflows that our customers (and their customers!) rely on every day, often in regulated manufacturing environments where correctness is non-negotiable.

Aligning with Benchling’s mission of creating the AI scientist, the PE team is pioneering how AI agents can be given tools and skills to optimize both how our customers execute their work and how they analyze and improve their procedures. As a member of the team you’ll have a front-row seat in pushing AI into the physical layers of life sciences development.

The team currently consists of six engineers working across multiple parts of the products with strong latitude to shape core decisions from UI design to UX flows to system architecture and implementation. The work is high-stakes and high-impact: the systems you build are used daily by scientists and operators running mission-critical scientific work, and correctness and attention to detail matter enormously.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Build and maintain core features across the workflow engine, recipes, and assays - full-stack across backend services and frontend product surfaces

- Contribute to the data modeling that underpins workflow graph s

What does success look like in 6 months?

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

Overview of the Role

You will build the Site Reliability Engineering function at Zego, embedding reliability, observability and operational excellence as core engineering concerns - AI is the primary lever for doing that at scale, not a bolt on.

- You will be our dedicated SRE, working alongside Systems Engineering and embedded with Product and Engineering across roughly 120 engineers. Teams own their services and their own on-call. You own the framework, the instrumentation and the AI tooling that makes that ownership work.

- You will make teams good at running what they build: alert quality over alert volume, runbooks an agent can execute rather than prose that describes, and diagnostics good enough that an engineer or an agent reaches resolution without an SRE in the room.

- You will be the primary advocate for reliability with Product and Engineering, making the case with data rather than assertion, so platform health is prioritised alongside delivery commitments.

- Define and land the reliability standard: SLIs, SLOs, error budgets and production readiness criteria that teams apply to their own services, with adoption measured rather than assumed.

- Encode standards into automation rather than enforcing them by hand. Guardrails in CI, agents that check reliability and observability posture on pull requests, and safe defaults in shared infrastructure so the reliable path is the easy path.

- Build SRE capability on Zego's AI platform, extending our MCP servers and agents, and making the estate legible to them through machine readable runbooks, structured telemetry and diagnostics an agent can act on.

- Own observability as a practice, including instrumentation design, signal quality, cardinality and cost.

- Raise the standard of incident response end-to-end, from detection and triage through to retrospectives that produce change. Put AI to work where it pays off most, stripping toil out of incidents so responders can focus on judgement

- Measure toil, publish it, and remove it through tooling that others can run without you.

What you will need to be successful in the Role

We are looking for an engineer who lives SRE and DevOps culture, and treats AI tooling as a default part of how the work gets done, not a side experiment. You will engage and empower teams through decisions grounded in data, and you will be as comfortable building with AI as consuming it: extending MCP servers, writing agents, and automating the operational work that would otherwise fill your week. We treat reliability at Zego as a platform capability, so we care more about what you can make repeatable for others than what you can fix yourself.

What you’ll bring to the Team

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Research Scientist Intern at Mercor, you’ll work on research at the frontier of post-training, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), data generation, and model evaluation.

You’ll investigate how datasets, rewards, and training methods affect the capabilities and behavior of large language models. This may include designing controlled experiments, developing new evaluation methodologies, conducting systematic failure analysis, and testing approaches to improve tool use, agentic behavior, and real-world reasoning.

You’ll work closely with research scientists, research engineers, and domain experts to turn open-ended questions into rigorous experiments. Your work will contribute to Mercor’s research agenda and may support external publications, benchmark releases, and the development of frontier AI systems.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Develop and investigate research questions related to post-training, RLVR, data quality, and model evaluation.

- Design and run controlled experiments to understand how datasets, rewards, and training strategies affect model performance.

- Study reward-shaping and post-training methods, including approaches such as GRPO and DAPO.

- Develop methods for measuring data quality, usability, and performance uplift on key benchmarks.

- Design and evaluate datasets, rubrics, evaluators, and scoring frameworks for complex model capabilities.

- Conduct systematic error analysis to identify model failure modes and opportunities for improvement.

- Analyze experimental results and communicate findings through clear reports, research artifacts, and presentations.

- Build the research tooling and data pipelines needed to conduct experiments at scale.

- Collaborate with research scientists, research engineers, applied AI teams, and domain experts producing training and evaluation data.

- Contribute to research publications, benchmark releases, and other public research outputs where appropriate.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- Currently pursuing a master’s or PhD in computer science, machine learning, statistics, mathematics, or another relevant field.

- Demonstrated ability to formulate research questions, design experiments, and draw sound conclusions from empirical results.

- Demonstrated experience in at least one of the following:

- Training, fine-tuning, or evaluating language models.

- Agentic AI system, RL environments

- Developing benchmarks, evaluation methodologies, or data-quality measures.

- At least one publication or open source project.

- Strong programming skills, particularly in Python, and the ability to write reliable research code.

- Familiarity with machine learning fundamentals, experimental design, and statistical analysis.

- Intellectual curiosity.

- Comfort operating in a fast-paced research environment with rapid iteration and a high degree of ownership.

NICE TO HAVE

- Previous research experience in language models, reinforcement learning, model evaluat

Foresight Diagnostics is a molecular diagnostics company pioneering non-invasive cancer detection through highly sensitive, cell-free DNA-based liquid biopsy technologies. Our proprietary methods - originally developed at Stanford University - are designed to detect smaller tumors earlier and enable more personalized treatment strategies for patients with cancer. 

We sit at the intersection of molecular biology, bioinformatics, and next-generation sequencing (NGS), and we translate rigorous science into clinically meaningful solutions. Following our acquisition by Natera, we now combine the agility of a mission-driven startup with the scale and resources of a global leader in cell-free DNA testing. It’s an exciting moment to join us. 

Headquartered in Boulder, Colorado, our team operates in a high accountability, collaborative environment where quality and continuous improvement aren’t just values - they’re how we work every day.

The Clinical Lab Supervisor is a leader in Natera's lab operations whose role is to oversee employees' performance and serve as a liaison between employees and senior management to meet company goals and quality objectives. The supervisor is responsible for daily supervision of lab staff performing duties such as laboratory testing and data review. Duties include but are not limited to coaching, motivating, staffing, evaluating, and training staff. The supervisor works closely with the manager to ensure company and team goals are met while adhering to good manufacturing practices and CLIA/CAP guidelines.

• Program liquid handling robots

• Build rapport with end-users, and coordinate with cross-functional teams

• Develop and integrate the automation systems and related software tools, preparing the documentation for equipment validation and operating procedures to ensure successful implementation in the labs

• Prepare User Requirement and Testing Procedure, Standard Operating Procedures, and related documentations

• Oversee the functional and validation testing, IQ/OQ/PQ 

• Additional responsibilities include user training, troubleshooting, optimizing the workflows, and on-going support for the end-users

QUALIFICATIONS:

• BS degree in Biomedical engineering, closely related scientific field, or equivalent; MS degree preferred

• 2+ years of laboratory automation engineering experience required

• Technical proficiency and experience in automation and systems development and integration for the life science industry; especially with robotics and liquid handling systems. 

• Experience in computer programing is required.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

• Strong project management skills, organizational skills, and written and verbal communication skills are required. 

• Flexibility and self-initiative required to support several simultaneous automation projects.  

• Biotech, pharmaceutical, Lab automation providers, or clinical-laboratory experience is highly desirable

As the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloft’s certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle.

Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.

We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that “EX = CX”: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.

Position Overview
Decision making in contract technology is shifting. Procurement, CFOs, and CIOs are gaining influence alongside Legal, and they expect contracting outcomes they can measure that are directly connected to company level business strategy. Agiloft has built deep strength with legal personas that will be extended into procurement through additional investments in our products.
As Senior Product Manager for Procurement, you will accelerate the development of procurement-focused contracting motions on our platform. You will identify the highest value procurement scenarios, prioritize for emerging customer demand, and turn them into a roadmap Product builds against.
This is a high-agency, high-accountability product and business building role reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer. You will create and prove value for procurement customers in close partnership with the teams building our core platform and our connected, third-party experiences and generate the evidence that shapes further investment in this motion.

title: Technical Accounting Lead, Ads Revenue
description:

OpenAI Finance ensures the organization is positioned for long-term success as we pursue our mission. The Revenue team plays a critical role in enabling OpenAI to scale commercial offerings by overseeing billing operations, deal desk, revenue systems, revenue accounting, and controllership. We work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Go-To-Market, Tax, Legal, and Technical Accounting to support new monetization strategies, improve operational efficiency, and maintain financial integrity as the business grows.

About the Role

This senior leader will own key elements of Ads revenue accounting from technical assessment through operational execution. The role will guide accounting for products, pricing, contracts, incentives, credits, refunds, makegoods, international expansion, and new go-to-market motions. It will establish governance and translate approved accounting positions into launch, billing, data, close, reconciliation, and control requirements. Success requires deep technical revenue expertise, strong business partnership, and the ability to build durable 0-to-1 processes in a fast-changing environment.

Advertising is a critical and growing monetization vector for OpenAI, and this role will help shape the financial foundations that enable Ads to scale responsibly and transparently.

This role can be based in San Francisco or New York City. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

- Own the operating cadence for incentive and makegood accounting, invoice readiness, accruals and reserves, settlements, reconciliations, GL tie-outs, flux analysis, reporting, and control evidence.

- Partner with Ads Product, Engineering, Data, Finance Engineering, Sales, Deal Desk, Legal, Tax, Billing, and Technical Accounting on launches, enterprise negotiations, and international expansion.

- Prepare concise technical memos and audit-ready support; align novel or material conclusions with Corporate Technical Accounting and external auditors.

- Use data, AI, and automation to improve research, monitoring, policy maintenance, issue tracking, documentation, and repeatable Finance workflows with appropriate review controls.

- 10+ years of progressive experience in revenue accounting, including direct ownership of complex ASC 606 judgments and operational execution.

- Demonstrated leadership to independently set direction, prioritize across competing risks, and influence senior cross-functional stakeholders.

- Experience with digital advertising, adtech, marketplaces, payments, usage-based services, or another high-volume transaction environment.

- Strong command of variable consideration, principal-versus-agent, contract modifications, incentives and credits, collectibility, estimates, and revenue presentation.

- Track record building 0-to-1 accounting processes, governance, close mechanisms, reconciliations, and controls that scale.

- Ability to turn technical conclusions into practical product, contract, billing, data, and operatin

title: Senior Service Designer, Food Systems & Fulfillment (f/m/x)
description:
The role

The Enterprise UX practice at HelloFresh is a cross-functional team that brings physical and digital product and service experiences to life through strategic research, service design, prototyping, and storytelling. We are dedicated to transforming enterprise ways of working by applying structured methods like Definition Sprints, Service Blueprinting, and AS-IS and TO-BE mapping, creating meaningful & effective enterprise experiences to shape the future of HelloFresh’s Supply Chain.
As a Senior Service Designer, you will leverage your research and service design expertise to shape compelling visions for both product and process improvements. You will deeply investigate current ways of working-identifying key data archetypes, mapping AS-IS states, and collaboratively defining desired TO-BE workflows. Your insights will identify the most impactful opportunities for investment. You will closely collaborate with product, engineering, users and operational stakeholders to design, prototype, and validate scalable solutions aligned with our Enterprise Design System.

About the Domain

The wider Food Systems Alliance owns technology that enables a lean and sustainable procurement process from Suppliers to HelloFresh facilities and improves customer experience with accurate ingredient data flow and optimal ingredient quality. Optimising cost of ingredients, providing customers with the freshest and best ingredients, and enabling buying decisions that reduce excess stock and other forms of inventory waste are just some of the focus areas for this alliance.

What you’ll do

• Conduct and lead strategic Definition Sprints to uncover user needs, validate hypotheses, and collaboratively define clear next steps for design and development.

• Map current (AS-IS) enterprise processes and systems, identifying pain points and opportunities, then collaboratively design optimized (TO-BE) processes, particularly within the Food Systems alliance  - the cluster that takes care of supply chain management topics within Hello Fresh..

• Partner and inspire other enterprise designers to excel in service design and prototyping, nurturing growth within the team.

• Deeply understand the user journeys and workflows of Recipe Developers, Menu Planners, and Buyers, building strong stakeholder relationships to advocate effectively for these users.

• Develop and align design concepts and prototypes with the Enterprise Design System to ensure scalability and consistency across enterprise tooling.

• Form collaborative partnerships with POs, engineers, and researchers, using influence to elevate UX solutions and challenge broader assumptions within internal product teams.

• Mentor and coach designers in creating user experiences demonstrating pride in craft, clarity, and effectiveness.

• Create UX/UI flows and experiences that elegantly address complex enterprise problems with delightful, user-centric solutions.

• Facilitate clear communication across teams, leveraging structured storytelling methods to amplify your impact.

Above all, we are looking for people who will  make HelloFresh   better.  We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll bring

• 4+ years of product design experience, particularly within enterprise or B2B contexts.

• Proven track record in applying structured service design methodologies such as Definition Sprints, AS-IS/TO-BE mapping, and Service Blueprinting.

• Additional experience leading projects, mentoring, or directly managing design team members.

• A portfolio demonstrating impactful, user-centered enterprise experiences and a high level of craft.

• Expertise in visual design, interaction design, UX writing, and UI design.

• Mastery of Figma and familiarity with relevant prototyping and service design tools.

title: Marketing Lead
description:
About AuthorClimb
AuthorClimb is the growth desk for self-published authors. We give KDP authors one toolkit to grow their books on Amazon: keyword rank tracking, sales analytics, listing optimization, A+ Content design, category research, and reader review distribution. We're a small, remote-first team headquartered in the Boston area, building for authors who treat their books like a business.
The role
You'll be our first senior marketing hire and the owner of the entire marketing function. Today, marketing at AuthorClimb is a set of working channels run close to the founder. Your job is to turn it into a system: sharpen the positioning, decide where we spend and why, and build the team that executes it. This is a player-coach role. You'll set strategy and you'll also write the launch email yourself when that's the fastest path.
You'll report directly to the founder and, as the team grows, manage our content and growth marketing hires.
What you'll do

• Own marketing strategy and the full funnel, from first impression through free trial to paid subscription

• Sharpen positioning and messaging for a skeptical, ambitious audience of self-published authors

• Set the channel mix across paid social, search, SEO content, email, and partnerships, and decide where the next dollar goes

• Define the metrics that matter, build honest measurement around them, and report on what's working without spin

• Run launches end to end: new tools, pricing changes, research reports, and brand moments

• Hire, manage, and develop the marketing team, starting with content and growth roles

• Write. Landing pages, emails, positioning docs. The bar for prose here is high

What we're looking for

• 6+ years in marketing with at least 2 years leading a function or team

• Experience growing a subscription software product, ideally one sold to prosumers or small businesses rather than enterprises

• A genuinely strong writer. You'll be asked for writing samples

• Fluency with funnel data: you can pull your own numbers, question an attribution story, and change course when the evidence says to

• A player-coach temperament: you've built strategy and you still enjoy shipping the work

• Comfortable being the most senior marketer in the room and owning outcomes without a playbook handed to you

Nice to have

• Familiarity with self-publishing, the creator economy, or marketplaces where individuals run small businesses

• Lifecycle and email marketing depth

• Experience building or repositioning a brand, not just running channels

Compensation & benefits

• $130,000-$165,000 base salary, depending on experience

• Health, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k) plan

• Flexible PTO plus company holidays

• $1,000 home-office setup budget

• An annual book stipend, naturally

How we work
We're fully remote across the US, with a home base in the Boston area. The team is small, communication is mostly written and async, and there's no layer between you and the founder. Work ships quickly and gets in front of real authors the same week.
Equal opportunity

title: Policy Design Manager, Integrity and Authenticity
locationText: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Washington, DC
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As an Integrity and Authenticity Policy Manager, you will be responsible for developing, refining, and maintaining policies that prevent the misuse of AI systems for deception, manipulation, and unauthorized monitoring at scale. You will serve as the policy owner for risks related to inauthentic behavior, influence activity, surveillance, and the profiling of individuals and groups, and you will help shape policy frameworks across several areas, including authenticity, information integrity, and privacy and surveillance.

Your initial focus will be on translating the Integrity and Authenticity risk framework into clear, enforceable policies, ensuring policy language addresses emerging threats identified by partner teams, and establishing guidelines that enable consistent enforcement decisions. Many of the most serious harms in this space begin with upstream steps that look routine on their own, such as compiling records about a person, automating account creation, or sorting users by inferred identity. Part of your work will be defining where those steps become prohibited. The role will expand as AI capabilities advance. Safety is core to our mission. You will help ensure our products cannot be used to deceive people at scale, monitor and profile people without their knowledge or consent, or sort and target populations based on sensitive characteristics.

Important context for this role: In this position you may be exposed to and engage with explicit content spanning a range of topics, including those of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature, as well as detailed descriptions of privacy violations, surveillance abuses, and deceptive campaigns targeting vulnerable people.

Key responsibilities

•
Develop and define policy boundaries for covert monitoring, tracking, and surveillance across different contexts, drawing the distinction between malicious behaviors and compliant dual-use scenarios

•
Write policy guidance on facial recognition, voice cloning, and geolocation inference, specifying which uses require consent and which are prohibited outright

•
Map the surveillance lifecycle, from target selection and data collection through analysis and covert deployment, and define the policy line at each stage so that interventions can occur early in the chain

•
Design and oversee evaluations that measure the model's capability to support social media monitoring, people-finding, predictive profiling, and the identification or tracking of specific people, to build, develop and improve safeguards with cross-functional partners to prevent malicious behaviors

•
Write and refine external-facing Usage Policy language and develop training guidelines, assessment rubrics, and evaluation protocols for enforcement teams, with emphasis on indicators of covert monitoring and population-level targeting

•
Validate enforcement decisions and automated assessments, provide policy guidance on complex edge cases such as investigative research into surveillance tools, coordinate with civil society, privacy experts, threat intelligence researchers, and academics, and serve as the escalation point for complex integrity and surveillance cases

Minimum qualifications

•
Working knowledge of how deceptive campaigns and covert monitoring operate in practice, including account networks, bot operations, data aggregation pipelines, and attribution methods

•
Familiarity with surveillance technologies and their misuse, including social media monitoring tools, people-search services, location tracking, spyware, facial recognition, and open-source intelligence techniques used against individuals

This is a remote position.

Partnership Executive/Investment Sales & Business Advisor
​ This is not a typical sales job. But it starts with sales.

We're looking for someone rare - a person who is wired to prospect, pitch, and close, AND sophisticated enough to act as a trusted business advisor to high-performing entrepreneurs.

If that describes you, keep reading.

What You're Selling

Fusion Growth Partners is an Inc. 5000 company (ranked 813th nationally) that invests capital, staff, and infrastructure directly into the businesses of residential real estate agents - helping them scale from solo producer to true enterprise. We fund their marketing, hire and pay their staff, and build the operational machine. Our partners don't pay us a coaching fee - we earn a return from the revenue growth we help them generate.

You are selling one of the most compelling business propositions in the market: growth funding with no out-of-pocket cost to the client, backed by a proven model and over 300 team members delivering the work.

The Role - Two Phases

Phase 1: Sales & Business Development (Inside Sales) You will prospect, present, and close new partner relationships. This means outbound outreach, structured sales conversations on Zoom, and guiding high-earning real estate professionals through a detailed evaluation of our investment model. Our close rate at the final deal stage exceeds 50%.

If you don't genuinely love the hunt - the calls, the follow-up, the pipeline - this is not for you. If you do, there are few better platforms to excel.

Phase 2: Advisory & Portfolio Management As your book of business grows, your role evolves. You become the board-level advisor to your partners - running strategy meetings, driving accountability, and ensuring every partner in your portfolio is growing. This is where sophistication matters. You must be able to influence strong-willed, high-income entrepreneurs and guide them to take actions that will benefit their business even when those actions require patience.

The Entrepreneurial Path - Build Something of Your Own

This is where it gets different.

Fusion is in a period of rapid national expansion. The opportunity ahead of you is not just a sales job - it is the foundation of your own business division within Fusion. As you prove yourself, you will have the opportunity to:

•
Become a Contract Negotiator (Hero) - running final deal meetings for the broader team, exclusively focused on closing

•
Build a Consulting Portfolio - your own book of partner clients generating recurring revenue-share income

•

Think of it less like climbing a corporate ladder and more like building a franchise within a proven system. The infrastructure, the brand, the model, and the clients are already here. The question is how big you want to build it.

Compensation & Earnings Potential

This is a commission-based, revenue-sharing role with a typical first-year earning potential of $70,000. As you build your partner portfolio and expand your book of business, your income potential scales rapidly realistic earnings can reach $250,000+ annually within your first three years. Commission is uncapped and directly tied to the growth of your portfolio and division, putting your earning power completely in your hands.

• You are looking for a high salaried position with limited performance pre

• Ability to translate concepts and messaging into clear visual experiences

Preferred

• Familiarity with 3D tools such as Blender, Cinema 4D, or similar for spatial mockups and previsualization

A portfolio is required for consideration. It should demonstrate strong visual thinking and the ability to communicate interactive or motion-based experiences. Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.

title: Független Értékesítő - Zalaegerszeg
description:
Helló! Mi vagyunk a Teya.
A Teya egy fizetési- és szoftverszolgáltatásokat nyújtó vállalat, londoni központtal. Célunk a kis- és közepes méretű, helyi vállalkozások támogatása Európa-szerte. 2019-es alapításunk óta olyan könnyen használható, integrált eszközöket fejlesztünk, amelyek segítik partnereinket a fizetések egyszerű elfogadásában, és hozzájárulnak üzleti teljesítményük javításához.

A Teyánál hiszünk abban, hogy a kisebb, helyi vállalkozások a közösségünk alapjai.
Azért vagyunk itt, mert úgy látjuk, a jelenlegi játéktér nem ad valódi esélyt a kisebb szereplőknek a nagyvállalatokkal szemben.
Azért dolgozunk, mert azt tapasztaljuk, hogy a bankok és a hagyományos szolgáltatók gyakran megnehezítik a helyi vállalkozások hatékony működését. Nem hisszük, hogy a legjobb technológia vagy szolgáltatás csak a legnagyobb cégeket illetné meg.
Egy olyan jövőért dolgozunk, ahol a kisebb vállalkozások is sikeresen működhetnek és ugyanolyan elkötelezettséggel támogatjuk őket, amilyennel ők nap mint nap építik a közösségünket.

Legyél a történetünk része!
Kivételes tehetségeket keresünk, akik csatlakoznának küldetésünkhöz. Nálunk lehetőséged van valódi hatást gyakorolni egy lendületes, összetartó közösségben. Támogatunk a folyamatos fejlődésben, büszkék vagyunk közös céljainkra, és átfogó juttatási csomagot kínálunk.

Csatlakozz csapatunkhoz, mint független értékesítő!

Proaktív személy vagy, aki szeret emberekkel beszélgetni és sok időt tölteni terepen? Kiváló kommunikációs készségeid vannak és szereted az értékesítést? Széles kapcsolati hálóval rendelkezel a vendéglátásban, kiskereskedelemben és a szépségiparban, vagy egyszerűen csak ismersz valakit szinte bármire?

A Teya-nál folyamatosan keressük azokat a független értékesítőket, akik képviselik szolgáltatásainkat kis- és középvállalkozások számára a fizetési megoldások területén.
A feladat egyszerű: találj egy ügyfelet, küldj neki ajánlatot, vidd fel felhasználóként, és a jutalék hamarosan a számládon landol.

Van saját céged vagy egyéni vállalkozásod? Remek! A vállalkozásod a hónap során általad hozott ügyfelek után számláz a Teya felé, így a bevételed teljes mértékben az általad elért eredményektől függ.

Miért dolgozz velünk:

- Rugalmasság: Dolgozz a saját feltételeid szerint, kezeld a saját időbeosztásod és határozd meg a prioritásaid

- Korlátlan kereseti lehetőség: Teljesítményalapú, magas jutalékrendszer, korlátlan potenciállal

- Függetlenség: Szabadság a saját vállalkozásod vezetésére, miközben igénybe veheted támogatásunkat és erőforrásainkat

- Kiváló megoldások: Dolgozz a legmodernebb kártyaelfogadó technológiával és POS eszközökkel

- Képzés és támogatás: Részletes képzést biztosítunk, hogy minél jobban megismerd szolgáltatásainkat, és folyamatos támogatást nyújtunk minden felmerülő kérdésre

Amit tőled várunk:

- Kiváló kommunikációs és prezentációs készségek

- Önálló munkavégzés és hatékony időgazdálkodás

- Ambíció, motiváció és könnyedség másokkal való kapcsolattartásban

- Ügyfélszerzés, termék- és szolgáltatásbemutatás, valamint sikeres értékesítés

- Előnyben részesülnek azok a jelöltek, akik terepi vagy személyes értékesítési tapasztalattal rendelkeznek, illetve széles kapcsolati hálóval a kiskereskedelem, vendéglátás és kapcsolódó ágazatok területén

Ha mindez jól hangzik, és szeretnél a saját feltételeid szerint dolgozni korlátlan kereseti lehetőséggel, örömmel várjuk jelentkezésedet!

A Teya elkötelezett az egyenlő esélyek biztosítása mellett.
Elkötelezettek vagyunk egy befogadó munkahelyi környezet kialakítása mellett, ahol mindenki, függetlenül származásától, nemi identitásától, szexuális irányultságától, életkorától, akadályoztatottságától, vallásától vagy hátterétől, kibontakozhat és a legjobbat hozhatja ki magából. Hisszük, hogy a sokszínű csapat kreatívabb ötletekhez, jobb eredményekhez és egy támogatóbb munkahelyhez vezet mindenki számára.

Ha a jelentkezési folyamat bármely szakaszában szükséged lenne bármilyen jellegű támogatásra vagy segítségre,

Role Overview
We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own how our clients get found in search and AI: more than 20,000 real estate websites, each competing in its own market, with a real business depending on the outcome. This is a platform product, where one good product decision reaches thousands of businesses at once.

The best people in this job design for three constituencies at once: the people who visit these sites, the crawlers and AI agents that read them, and the real estate business whose revenue depends on both.
This is a product leadership role. You'll run this area like a business: set the strategy, ship with your own engineering team, and work across design, client success, and sales to make it land. You run your area like a business. You build the case before you build the product, tie your roadmap to retention and revenue, and own the result

Rigorous about measurement. You test before you scale and can tell a result from a coincidence
Fluent with AI as a working tool, using it to investigate, prototype, and unblock yourself

title: Medical Biller/ Coder (OB/GYN coder)
description:
About Diana Health

Diana Health is a network of modern women’s health practices working in partnership with hospitals to reimagine the maternity and women’s healthcare experience. We are restructuring the traditional approach to care to create an experience that is good for patients and good for providers. We do that by combining a tech-enabled, wellness-focused care program that women love with a clinical system that helps us drive continuous quality improvement and ensure work-life balance for our care team. We work with clients across all life stages to empower and support them to live happier, healthier, more fulfilling lives.
With strong collaborative care teams; passionate administrators and a significant investment in operational support, Diana Health employees are well-supported to bring their very best to the work they love. Come join us!
Role Description
Diana Health is seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Medical Biller / Coder to join our Revenue Cycle team. In this role, you’ll ensure the accurate coding of medical procedures and diagnoses across our diverse range of services including inpatient, outpatient, ambulatory, and specialty care. You’ll play a key role in supporting compliance, optimizing reimbursements, and ensuring all documentation aligns with federal and state regulations.
What You’ll Do
• Review clinical documentation and diagnostic results to ensure accurate CPT and ICD-10 coding.
• Validate medical necessity and ensure coding aligns with CMS and payer-specific guidelines.
• Process charge captures and review billing system edits to prevent claim denials.
• Collaborate with providers and billing teams to clarify documentation or coding inconsistencies.
• Identify coding trends, resolve payer denials, and provide recommendations for improvement.
• Assist with provider education on documentation and coding compliance.
• Maintain production standards and report daily coding productivity and quality metrics.
Qualifications
Education & Experience:
• High School Diploma or GED required.
• Completion of a formal coding program (AHIMA, CCS, or AAPC preferred).
• Minimum of 3 years’ applied coding experience OR 5 years of OB/GYN coding experience in a physician billing or revenue cycle setting; Emphasize on OB/GYN coding!
• Proficiency in ICD-10, CPT, medical terminology, anatomy, and health record content.
Licensure/Certification:
• Certified Professional Coder (CPC) or Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) preferred.
• Non-certified coders with strong experience may be required to obtain certification within an agreed timeframe.
Key Skills
• In-depth knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care plans (HMO, PPO, POS, Indemnity).
• Understanding of HIPAA, Medicare Fraud and Abuse regulations, and EHR/Billing systems.
• Strong analytical and organizational skills with attention to detail.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) and healthcare billing platforms.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Customer-focused approach and ability to work effectively with clinical staff and patients.
Why Join Diana Health
At Diana Health , we believe in advancing women’s healthcare through compassion, integrity, and innovation. As a member of our Revenue Cycle team, you’ll play a vital role in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of our financial operations while supporting patient-centered care.
Benefits

• Competitive compensation

• Medical, dental & vision plans, with an HSA/FSA option

• 401(k) with employer match

• Paid time off

• Paid parental leave

Diana Health Culture

• Having a growth mindset and striving for continuous learning and improvement

• Positive, can do / how can I help attitude

• Empathy for our team and our clients

• Taking ownership and driving to results

• Being scrappy and resourceful

title: Events Specialist
description:
We're looking for someone to run our international conference programme and exhibitions, as well as our own customer events and webinars. Full-time, permanent, UK-based, and fully remote.
Salary £30,000 - £40,000 (depending on experience).
Closing date: Sunday 8th November
Industry: Education and Software, with a focus on medical and health professional education.
Why this role exists
Our customers rely on the risr/ platform to deliver high-stakes and workplace-based assessments that really matter to institutions, professionals, and ultimately patient care.
Events are one of the main ways we meet leads and key decision-makers at organisations we want to work with, and stay close to the customers we have. In 2026, that means around 25 conferences and exhibitions across the UK, Europe, North America, and Australia; our own community days and customer events in each region; and a regular programme of webinars and user groups. Many of these are planned a year or more ahead.
This role exists to give every one of those events a single owner, from first booking to final report. Nothing slips, every deadline is met, and our go-to-market team can focus on conversations rather than logistics.
The role at a glance
As our Events Specialist, you’ll own the delivery of every risr/ event: international conferences and exhibitions, our own in-person community days and customer events, and our webinars and online events.
Our go-to-market team (marketing, business development and account management) decides which events we attend and what we want from them, and you make them happen. You’ll book the space, manage the suppliers, meet every exhibitor deadline, get the right people and materials to the right place, and report back on each event's costs and outcomes.
Most of the work is done remotely from the UK. You’ll attend some UK events in person, and occasionally travel overseas, to see how our events run on the ground and to understand the market and our competitors.
You might currently be an events manager, events executive or conference coordinator. What matters is that you’ve run events from start to finish.
Requirements

Conferences and exhibitions

• Turn the go-to-market team’s event decisions into one clear, shared events calendar, planned far enough ahead to secure good space and rates.

• Book exhibition space, sponsorships, and memberships, and track the contracts, payment dates, and deadlines that come with them.

• Own the exhibitor portal for every event, ensuring insurance documents, risk assessments, company information, branding, and team registrations are submitted on time.

• Book stand furniture, power, AV and any other on-site services.

• Arrange shipping of stand kit and materials, including customs requirements for events outside the UK.

• Work with the regional marketing leads to order print and collateral, so the right materials arrive in the right place.

• Coordinate speaking slots with organisers, including abstracts, slide decks and speaker details, so submissions are made on time.

• Put together a detailed briefing on the event schedule, exhibit hours, contact details, the leads form link, and exhibitor and sponsor information in a team document, including clear goals and outcomes, and review it in a pre- and post-event call.

• Build strong relationships with event organisers, so we hear about opportunities early and maintain good terms on sponsorships.

risr/ -hosted events

• Find, compare and book venues, and organise catering, AV and accessibility needs.

• Manage registrations, prepare attendee communications, and coordinate on-the-day logistics.

• Order and coordinate the print and delivery of event materials and services.

• Manage event resources and materials

Webinars and online events

You’ll work cross-functionally with internal and external teams, rallying people from planning through production and on the ground. • Work with content capture teams so every event produces strong stories and shareable content.

title: Sales Recruiter
description:
Our Sales team is often the first group a founder or business owner talks to at Mercury , and the people who help them as their company grows. Who we hire onto that team shapes how customers experience Mercury .
We're looking for a Sales Recruiter to help build and scale that team. You'll own full-cycle searches across our sales organization, from high-volume roles like Sales Development Representatives to Account Executives and post-sales roles like Relationship Managers and Account Development. You'll work closely with hiring managers and senior recruiters, run searches end to end, and help improve how our recruiting team operates as we grow.
This role is a good fit for someone who is organized, proactive, and comfortable owning their work. You should enjoy learning a new business quickly, work well with autonomy, and care about giving every candidate a thoughtful experience.
What you'll do

• Own full-cycle recruiting for Account Executive, Sales Development, Relationship Manager, and Account Development roles, from sourcing to close

• Run kickoffs and calibration sessions with hiring managers to define what a strong candidate looks like, and adjust the search as you learn

• Identify and engage strong candidates through sourcing and inbound channels, using funnel data to decide where to spend your time

• Communicate clearly and consistently with stakeholders on pipeline health, progress, blockers, and recruiting timeline

• Represent Mercury to candidates, sharing our mission, culture, and what it's like to join a growing sales organization

• Spot opportunities to improve recruiting processes, tools, and documentation, and share them with the team

• Manage offers and closing for your searches

• 2+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including at least 1 year in-house, ideally with sales roles such as account executives, SDRs, or account management

• Strong organization and attention to detail, with experience managing several searches at once, including at least one high-volume role

• Strong sourcing skills and ability to write compelling outreach

• Ability to work with recruiting data, such as pass-through rates and time to hire, to track your searches and spot where they're getting stuck

• Experience building strong relationships with hiring managers, including giving clear feedback and pushing back when needed

• Experience independently managing searches end to end, and knowing when to ask for help

• Comfort with some ambiguity, and a habit of seeking out feedback and applying it

• Experience recruiting at a fintech, SaaS, or high-growth startup

• Familiarity with Greenhouse, Gem, or similar recruiting tools

title: Senior Software Engineer, AI
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our growing AI organization in Vancouver. Asana is pioneering a new category of technology as the human-agent operating system, doubling down on our AI Suite to move our customers toward expansive, end-to-end intelligent orchestration. We are expanding several of our key AI engineering teams: depending on where you land, you might lead architecture across our core agentic runtime, develop high-throughput evaluation and safety infrastructure, or build the sophisticated customer-facing builders and canvas surfaces that allow enterprises to coordinate humans and AI agents seamlessly. Because this is an organization-wide search across our AI teams, you will participate in a single, streamlined technical interview process, and we will work with you to match you to the ideal team at the end of your interview experience.

This role is based in our Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

• Drive the technical design, architecture, and end-to-end delivery of medium-to-large projects across our AI roadmap, guiding and collaborating with multiple engineers.

• Design robust, extensible, and performant systems that support agentic execution, prompt-driven automation, model orchestration, and strict enterprise-grade data boundaries.

• Solve complex technical problems by weighing technical debt, developer velocity, execution risk, and direct business goals.

• Anticipate customer and architectural risks early, breaking down complex, ambiguous product visions into clear engineering milestones and actionable tasks.

• Champion technical excellence, write high-leverage design docs, run meaningful retrospectives, establish testing norms, and mentor engineers across levels to raise the engineering bar.

• Partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Product Designers, and Data Scientists to define requirements, clarify trade-offs, and align technical direction with Asana's broader product strategy.

About you

• Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

• 6+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, building, and maintaining production distributed systems, microservices, or complex full-stack architectures.

• Demonstrated track record of technical leadership across multiple services or codebases, with practical experience or deep interest in LLMs, agentic patterns, evaluation pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or real-time streaming infrastructure.

• Proven ability to author comprehensive technical design docs, evaluate trade-offs (e.g., latency, cost, determinism, maintainability), and make durable architectural decisions.

• Track record of acting as a Tech Lead or Area of Responsibility (AoR) owner-successfully driving multi-contributor projects from ambiguity to delivery while navigating cross-team dependencies.

• Passion for mentoring and coaching fellow engineers, providing actionable code and design feedback, and establishing long-term engineering best practices.

• Deep empathy for the end-user experience, understanding how backend architecture and model behaviours directly affect user trust, interface latency, and workflow reliability.
